outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is phase contrast micrographs, not a plot.
Bottom bar chart in panel C (percentage of cells) shows individual data points (n=3 dots per bar) overlaid on the mean ± SEM bars.
Bottom bar chart in panel D shows individual data points (n=3 dots per bar) overlaid on the mean ± SD bars.
Panel E is a heatmap, which is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel F is a western blot, not a plot of averaged data.
Both bar charts in panel G display individual data points (n=3 markers) overlaid on the mean ± SEM bars.
Panel H is immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot.
